title: TNIF (TECHNOLOGICAL INFECTION)
description: This modpack features many technology mods with the main threat being a fungal infection.
body:
**This modpack requires 4 gigabytes of ram, please ensure your device has significantly more than this or it will not be able to handle the modpack. Also if something doesn't work update the modpack first.**
# What is TNIF?
TNIF is a technology focused kitchen sink modpack with added bosses example being [Qliphoth Awakening](https://modrinth.com/mod/qliphoth-awakening) and main threat to all your technology and life being the [Fungal Infection](https://modrinth.com/mod/fungal-infectionspore). This modpack features mods like [Mekanism](https://modrinth.com/mod/mekanism), [Immersive Engineering](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersiveengineering), [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create), [PneumaticCraft: Repressurized](https://modrinth.com/mod/pneumaticcraft-repressurized), [Oritech](https://modrinth.com/mod/oritech) and don't forget the mod [Superb Warfare](https://modrinth.com/mod/superb-warfare)! Which gives you [Superb Warfare](https://modrinth.com/mod/superb-warfare)! With all kinds of weapons designed to kill your worst foes! (or friends)
# Gameplay
The gameplay has you balancing tech and weapons to fight the spore, if you take too long you might have to pack up with the Proto Hivemind arriving after around at least a minecraft week (2 hours and 20 minutes, depends on biome and if village is present nearby or not) at your base or area you're most at. Even sometimes you have to return back to old vanilla ways with getting enchantments from villagers like silk touch with ore blocks valued higher than just normal ore especially in [Mekanism](https://modrinth.com/mod/mekanism).
# Tips
- I recommend getting weapons like the homemade shotgun and C4 as it's easy to acquire and quite powerful. Though one downside is the Homemade Shotgun has low durability because of it's crude construction.
- You should get [Immersive Engineering](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersiveengineering) crates for when you need to pack up away from a proto hivemind (You seal the crates via right clicking with the [Immersive Engineering's](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersiveengineering) Hammer.)
- Even if you pack up away to some place else, don't just let a proto hivemind exist you need to destroy it eventually or else it will cause problems in the future, spawning the worst of the worst mobs. If three proto hiveminds exist in a world at once... I wish you the best luck.
- Racing to the end might be a good idea as the End Cities have good gear and _blueprints_ which let you craft better and more powerful weapons.
